protocolo: Pre-declared design note, section S5; runs ONCE
pergunta: where a one-variable physical floor lies, and where the external products lie, on the same reserve skill scale and against the lidar

definicoes.skill: eq. (1): S = 1 - MAE(D^)/MAE(D-), D- = unweighted mean of y at the lab==0 anchors of the quadrant (per seed); union = mean of the per-quadrant S weighted by n (b2_transferencia.avaliar, braco_arvores.avaliar)
definicoes.ancoras: b2_transferencia.preparar_peca(amazonia, q, seed, BLOCO, v23, True, True, False, False, False, True), BOOST_ATL08=4 (as in braco_arvores)
definicoes.pesos_por_fonte: ATL08 (fonte>=2) weighted x4, all others x1
definicoes.baseline: D^ = a + b*h_eth, WLS on the training anchors of the union, per seed

cobertura.nota: baseline valid where h ETH is finite; networks predict over the whole reserve; products where GLO-30 - product is finite. The reserve is fixed across seeds (geometric); coverage is the same in all 5.

arvore (carimbado, sem predicao persisti.intersecao: not computable: the tree model has no persisted prediction (S7)

produto_baseline.definicao: z = GLO-30 - (a_bar + b_bar * h_eth), h_eth = laterais_nativa_diretas/dossel_eth h_dossel (same column as the ETH class); a_bar, b_bar = mean over the 5 seeds (= mean of the 5 predictions, as for v23/mlp)

leitura_pre_declarada.regra: LS_u = max(|lo|,|hi|) of the 95% CI of the median of dMAE(v23 - baseline) in >30 m; saida_1 if, in the transect AND footprint units, LS_u < the lower bound of A (mean AND median) in the same unit (auditar_rotulo_regua_v2.json); otherwise saida_2 (rule recorded before running)
leitura_pre_declarada.texto_pre_declarado: the claim holds between the learned families, and the one-variable correction is worse by X m

X_m.nota: dMAE = MAE(v23) - MAE(baseline); negative = baseline worse (v23 with lower MAE); positive = baseline better
